name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_011_combined_owner_openref_near_camp_dual_brazier
description: R011 disposable two-source combined fire signal arm from owner open-reference save; a controlled cannibal camp footprint is one OMT from the house. Downstairs fire supplies same-level smoke and roof fire supplies exposed light; setup is not natural generation.

steps.label: load_staged_owner_open_reference_pre_signal_copy
steps.expected_visible_fact: Load only this disposable profile. Confirm 45/45 source save files except overmaps/o.0.0.zzip remain byte-identical; that file contains only the controlled cannibal camp footprint at OMT [132,143,0]. Verify same-run World/current turn, Safe Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no pending input, both prepared braziers unlit and no prior site knowledge/signal/outing.

steps.label: controlled_camp_fixture_recorded
steps.expected_visible_fact: Fixture setup only: one cannibal_camp special footprint at [132,143,0], copied from existing controlled-site template. No player, dimension-data, roster, site knowledge, report, action or contact fields were changed.

steps.label: ordinary_two_brazier_combined_smoke_light_to_cannibal_assault
steps.objective: From the staged clean pre-signal copy, verify both ordinary braziers and fuel, then ignite the downstairs and roof brazier through ordinary lighter actions. No clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability, teleport or debug signal/contact/report injection. Keep both fires burning. The downstairs same-level source is the smoke arm; the exposed roof source is the light arm. Verify each physical packet and camp range/LOS before observing response, then track same-ID actors through scouting/watch/return/report and any natural night raid/combat. Keep this labeled as two-source combined signals, not one fire emitting both signals.
proof_targets: exact disposable 45-file clean save copy, current effective userdir and same-run World/turn; source/executable/session binding
unlit pre-signal camp baseline, Safe mode Off, no prior smoke/light/contact/knowledge/outing and no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability; controlled camp geometry setup only
ordinary ladder route and native level transition to roof; actual brazier tile and ordinary lighter ignition with fresh advertised IDs
run-bound physical fd_fire and actual physical light and smoke channels from the real fire before response
actual same-ID camp admission, physical scout/watch/return/report and any natural night assault/combat with actor action/target/health/damage source
native quicksave turns and payloads at signal/admission/dispatch/return/combat; simulation timings
exact game/bridge/launcher PID and birth lifecycle, supported close and verified OS exit
invariants: No signal/contact/report/dispatch/fire/light injection, hostile teleport, clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability or debug raider kill
Keep the combined light-plus-smoke arm separate from the ordinary closed-room smoke-only arm
Controlled camp-site geometry is setup only, not natural generation or initial knowledge
Use only the ordinary route and advertised action targets; verify each menu result and never batch unobserved movement
Track all relevant actors by metadata and saved roster, including outside player sight; phase labels alone do not establish an assault
Maintain roof brazier fire through observation unless a concrete safety blocker requires stopping

evidence_contract.claim: In a disposable owner-reference copy with only the controlled cannibal camp footprint changed, two existing ordinary braziers produce separate physical smoke and exposed-light sources that both reach the eligible camp; assess resulting native same-ID scout/report/raid behavior.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Credit combined behavior only if this run shows both physical packets, both channel admission reads with actual range/LOS, and later same-ID actor state; do not infer from setup, phase labels, or another arm.
